title: Broker-connectivity Trusted-Beta release gate
authority_note: Decision matrix only. NO recommendation is made until certification completes: `recommendation` is null and every gate item is PENDING. This artefact arms nothing and does not authorise Trusted Beta. The recommendation, when made, is the Sponsor's decision.

decision_matrix.GO: Every gate item PASS with captured evidence; zero open HIGH/MEDIUM findings; Customer-Zero no-drift + production no-trade proven; rollback rehearsed; capacity baselines measured; Sponsor arming approval given.
decision_matrix.GO_WITH_CONDITIONS: ALL safety-critical gate items PASS — every area in safety_critical_areas (isolation B, execution-safety D, health E, failure-injection H, recovery I, rollback J) PLUS GATE-CZ (CZ no-drift + production no-trade), GATE-REV (no open HIGH/MEDIUM) and GATE-SPON — with one or more NON-safety gate items (areas A, C, F, G, K) at PARTIAL under an explicit, time-bounded, Sponsor-accepted condition with a named owner. A non-safety item at hard FAIL is NOT eligible for GO_WITH_CONDITIONS: it is NO_GO unless the Sponsor first downgrades it to an accepted PARTIAL condition. No safety-critical item may ever be a 'condition'.
decision_matrix.NO_GO: Any safety-critical gate item (safety_critical_areas + GATE-CZ/GATE-REV/GATE-SPON) at FAIL or PARTIAL (isolation breach, ineligible execution permitted, cross-account leakage, rollback cannot restore safe state, health not converging, CZ/production contamination), OR any open HIGH/MEDIUM finding, OR missing Sponsor approval, OR any blocks_go gate item at hard FAIL that the Sponsor has not accepted as a PARTIAL condition.

gate_items.requirement: Certification environment ready: disposable demo accounts/users only; CZ + live excluded; validation image verified; evidence + monitoring wired
Isolation proven across account/runtime/validation/event/execution/health/credential/operator, single + multi user/account + cross-account attempts
gate_items.pass_criteria: Zero cross-tenant access; all ISO cases PASS
No unsafe interleaving; all CON cases PASS

gate_items.requirement: Execution safety: every exposure-opening route gated at creation + claim + dispatch; pause/resume/invalidation/test-order/scheduler/promotion; full route inventory covered
gate_items.pass_criteria: Zero ineligible execution; every inventory route covered; drift guard green

gate_items.requirement: Health: all 6 states + transitions + convergence + pause generation + resume eligibility + no-auto-resume + state-version monotonicity
gate_items.pass_criteria: Deterministic transitions; no auto-resume; monotonic version; all HEA cases PASS

gate_items.requirement: Operational events: projection correctness/dedup/visibility/completeness/summary/rollback/disable; NO rebuild tool
gate_items.pass_criteria: All OPE cases PASS; no forbidden metadata; no false rebuild claim

gate_items.requirement: Every one of the 17 support workflows exercised with expected UI/events/audit/operator actions
Failure injection: backend/agent/validation/worker/timeout/bridge/credential/health/projection/db-rollback/network — each fail-closed or fail-open as designed
gate_items.pass_criteria: Every injected fault yields the expected safe state; all FAIL cases PASS

gate_items.requirement: Recovery: backend/agent/worker/projection/scheduler restart + validation retry + health convergence + execution restart
gate_items.pass_criteria: No duplicate/ineligible action on recovery; all REC cases PASS

gate_items.requirement: Rollback rehearsed: flag/image/backend/agent/validation-image + disposable DB restore
gate_items.pass_criteria: Every rollback path rehearsed and restores a safe state; all RBK cases PASS

gate_items.requirement: Capacity baselines measured (validation/execution throughput, queue depth, operator/support capacity, concurrency, health latency, event lag, response times)
gate_items.pass_criteria: Every capacity dimension MEASURED (no invented threshold); limits set with evidence. Prerequisite: CAP-9 (event lag) and CAP-10 (operator-API error/response) signals do not exist yet and must first be ADDED as metrics (engineering outside this planning packet) before they can be measured.

gate_items.requirement: Customer Zero no-drift + production no-trade throughout certification
gate_items.evidence_ref: wp6-evidence.json cross (golden STOP-check, CZ order-count 0, production no-trade)
gate_items.pass_criteria: CZ byte-identical; zero orders against CZ/production

gate_items.requirement: Sponsor arming approval with cohort + capacity limit + stop conditions
gate_items.pass_criteria: Explicit Sponsor GO with named cohort + limits

wp6.note: WP6 is authorised as a certification programme; the PLAN is complete, execution is NOT (requires disposable environment + Sponsor-gated runs). No release recommendation until execution completes.
